summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Zhihu Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong Stock Exchange rules. It details share repurchases (3,721,614 shares cancelled at ~$1.12/share) and conversion of Class B to Class A ordinary shares (213,023 shares) on April 27, 2026. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. The filing is a standard disclosure of capital structure changes, not a material special situation. Therefore, no category applies.
